meta.scope: Reconcile S755 published Results narrative against Table 4 and the unsupported Discussion accuracy statement

records.title: Choice of spinal cord stimulation versus targeted drug delivery in the management of chronic pain: a predictive formula for outcomes

searches.query: 10.1136/rapm-2019-100859 exact success definition analysis denominator and validation split

updates.ограничения: Publisher Methods defines SCS success as at least 50% pain relief from the trial and subsequent implant. Results reports 945 included and Table 1 partitions 826 SCS successes and 119 failures later treated with TDD, but no model-specific complete-case denominator or fixed follow-up horizon is stated. The narrative predictive formula includes a +0.468 postlaminectomy term that Table 4 omits; the printed formula is internally inconsistent. Discussion mentions 95% cross-validation accuracy without its denominator, split protocol or confusion matrix, while Results reports AUC 0.7414. This is single-center derivation, not external validation; no ECAP.

validation.notes.value: Publisher BMJ full-text JATS XML checked 2026-09-27. Methods defines at least 50% pain relief from trial and subsequent implant. Results/Table 1 report 945 included (826 successes, 119 failures); the exact model complete-case N and fixed outcome horizon are not reported. Results narrative includes a +0.468 postlaminectomy coefficient omitted from Table 4. Discussion states 95% cross-validation accuracy without a printed split, denominator or confusion matrix; Results separately reports AUC 0.7414. No patient-disjoint or external validation is inferred. Data are available on reasonable request; no ECAP predictor is described.
